newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on
Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government to provide new teacher recruits with pre-service training, under Asian Development Bank funded project.
Veteran left politician, Pieter Keuneman dies at age of 80.

Government reposseses six 'peoplised' ventures, which were mismanaged, official sources said. The govenrement last year passed a law permiting it to reposses, restructure and privatise, ventures being badly managed after being handed over to the private sector.
About 15 Tamil separatist rebels killed and many injured, when security forces repulsed attack on forward defence lines in eastern Vavunia district, defence sources say.
Navy sinks boat packed with separatist rebels in Mullaitivu sea, in eastern Sri Lanka.
Twenty nine Sri Lankan illegal immigrants deported from Greece arrive in Colombo. Another 22 to return soon.
Local government elections likely to be held on March 27.
